title: Principality of Reuss-Gera
capsule: The Principality of Reuss-Gera (Junior Line) was a sovereign German state in Thuringia's Vogtland, created by the Confederation of the Rhine on 9 April 1806, ruled by the House of Reuss whose idiosyncratic custom assigned every male the name Heinrich with a numeral resetting each century. Covering approximately 827 km², it joined the German Confederation in 1815, the North German Confederation in 1866, and the German Empire in 1871. The last reigning prince abdicated on 11 November 1918 during the German Revolution; the principality merged with the Elder Line of Reuss in 1919 and was absorbed into the Free State of Thuringia in 1920.
